TEXT:
[FI] Finally, Kuroneko and I, having no other place we 
could think of going to, eventually made our way to 
the arcade.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, this place is more suited for us after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What's wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No, it's nothing.

[FI] This place's unique ambiance keeps you from 
calming down.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Do you have any game you want to play?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's not like I do, although...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Speaking of which, I haven't seen you play much 
lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] What do you mean? Bringing this up out of the 
blue...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Nah, it's just been awhile. I just wanted to see you 
playing games.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You already know of my skills, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's true, but did you get better since then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...But, wouldn't that be boring for you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Nah, not at all.

[FI] It's not just fighting games, but for any game, we 
spectators get a kick out of watching skilled 
players. Even more so if that player's my girlfriend.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] If you put it that way, I guess I might as well.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Now then, I will have you witness my magnificent 
victories.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Let us begin. Darker than the still of midnight, the 
devil's banquet...

SPEAKER: SPK_COMMENTARY
TEXT:
[FI] Whoa! The challenger's been driven to the corner?! 
There's no way out now!

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT: [FI] Hey, it's a 20-win streak now...

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_2
TEXT: [FI] But if it's him... that "Inazuma" guy will surely...!

SPEAKER: SPK_COMMENTARY
TEXT:
[FI] The challenger's putting it all on the line! He's using 
a super!

SPEAKER: SPK_COMMENTARY
TEXT:
[FI] ...Huh? What? She blocked every hit of that 
fearsome attack...? Whoa! It's a total reversal!

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT:
[FI] Amazing, she escaped the corner by putting her 
opponent in it!

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_2
TEXT:
[FI] Hey whoa, are you serious...? Her inputs are 
frame-perfect?!

SPEAKER: SPK_COMMENTARY
TEXT:
[FI] An awesome comeback from the corner! Here 
comes the final blow!!

SPEAKER: SPK_OTAKU_1
TEXT:
[FI] N-No way, what kind of godly play is this! Is this 
even for real?!

[FI] As Kuroneko's win advanced her to the next round, 
I noticed that the fighting games corner attracted 
a crowd.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I mean, just where did all these people come 
from?!

[FI] I don't know when this happened, but there are 
people commentating over her matches. There 
weren't many people here earlier...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Hmph, too naive. You can't outlast my combo like 
that...
[FI] Kuroneko's being Kuroneko. She's totally into it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmm?

[FI] At this moment, I noticed a notebook tied to the 
side of the game cabinet.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Record book? Inside is... a record of the matches of 
this game?

[FI] What's written here is a record of win streaks for 
the month. The more pages I turned, the more I 
grew perplexed. The contents:

[FI] 〇〇/〇〇 〇〇:〇〇, Girl in Black Cosplay 32-win 
streak.

[FI] ××/〇〇 △△:△△, Girl in Black Cosplay record 
update. 37-win streak.

[FI] It continued like that in different handwriting. This 
"Girl in Black Cosplay", it's gotta be Kuroneko, 
right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Just many times have you been to this arcade, 
Kuroneko...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] And that's that. Were you watching?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, it was an intense battle!

[FI] She was so strong, I started sympathizing with the 
challengers. Well, it's not like I would cheer for 
anyone other than Kuroneko, of course.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You're truly amazing.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I-I'm not that amazing...

[FI] For some reason, Kuroneko started fidgeting with 
her fingers, looking down bashfully. HNNGGHH! This 
is when she's the cutest, yeah!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] By the way, Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Earlier, I took a look at the attached record 
notebook.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Ah, that...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] No matter how many times I considered it, those 
win streaks can only be from you, are you a 
regular here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] It's not like that. It's just that I've been around this 
area lately.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, but why?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] It's just a rumor I heard but, the legendary 
champion of the Siscaly World Tournament comes 
here often.

[FI] The Siscaly World Tournament. The one Kuroneko 
participated in and lost.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] So you were looking for that person, hence 
spending time here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But in the end, we have yet to meet each other...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] I see. But you could probably still win, as you are 
now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I'm not that good. Frankly speaking, the victory 
today can't be considered flawless...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Is that how things work...

[FI] It seems that this world goes deeper than I 
thought.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...With your support, perhaps I can do it after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] All things considered, there's no one left to oppose 
you here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's not exactly true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] You mean there's someone else around here that's 
stronger than you?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Going by Akagi-san's words, it does seem that way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I never got to meet that person in the end...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I see.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Well, gaining supremacy of this region isn't a bad 
thing either.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey now...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] I'm joking. I don't have much time for that these 
days.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's good then.

[FI] When I consider her skills, it'll be dreadful if she's 
able to achieve that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] [font_size=17]So you're not going to ask "What are you busy with lately"? Who do 
you think I'm using up my time for...[/font_size]

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm? What is it, Kuroneko?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] No, it's nothing. Yes, nothing at all...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Shall we get going then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Are you satisfied?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Yes. I planned to show you my glory, that goal has 
now been achieved.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT:
[FI] Besides, it seems like you don't have much interest 
in the games here?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Hey, you shouldn't be so quick to judge, alright? 
Even I have games I want to play...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my, which one then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT:
[FI] Umm... There. That one! I'm really interested in that 
one!
